intro.en: A biography of Clara Campoamor, who won the vote for Spanish women. All the past tenses at work.

texto.en:
- The **indefinido** carries the milestones: **nació**, **se licenció**, **falleció**.
- The **imperfecto** gives the background to one of them: cuando **tenía** diez años…
- The **passive** fits public events: **fue elegida**, **fue aprobado**.
- What someone argued for or asked for goes in the **past subjunctive**: defendió que las mujeres **pudieran** votar; le pidieron que **esperara**.
- A **compound infinitive** looks back: sin **haber podido** volver.

Useful biography words: **nacer**, **criarse**, **licenciarse**, **casarse**, **trasladarse**, **fallecer**; **a los** treinta años; **en** 1931; **tras** la guerra; **al** estallar la guerra.

frases.es: Clara Campoamor nació en Madrid en 1888, en una familia humilde.
frases.en: Clara Campoamor was born in Madrid in 1888, into a modest family.

frases.es: Cuando tenía diez años murió su padre, por lo que tuvo que dejar la escuela y ponerse a trabajar.
frases.en: When she was ten her father died, so she had to leave school and start working.

frases.es: Fue costurera, dependienta y telefonista antes de volver a estudiar.
frases.en: She was a seamstress, a shop assistant and a telephone operator before going back to study.

frases.es: A pesar de las dificultades, se licenció en Derecho a los treinta y seis años.
frases.en: In spite of the difficulties, she graduated in Law at the age of thirty-six.
analisis: a los treinta y seis años

frases.es: En 1931 fue elegida diputada y defendió en el Parlamento que las mujeres pudieran votar.
frases.en: In 1931 she was elected to parliament and argued there that women should be able to vote.

frases.es: Muchos compañeros, incluso de su propio partido, le pidieron que esperara.
frases.en: Many colleagues, even from her own party, asked her to wait.

frases.es: Ella se negó, y el voto femenino fue aprobado el 1 de octubre de 1931.
frases.en: She refused, and women's suffrage was approved on 1 October 1931.

frases.es: Al estallar la guerra civil tuvo que exiliarse, y falleció en Suiza en 1972 sin haber podido volver.
frases.en: When the civil war broke out she had to go into exile, and she died in Switzerland in 1972 without having been able to return.

pregunta.en: Why did Clara have to leave school?

Her father died and she had to work.en: Murió su padre, por lo que tuvo que dejar la escuela.

She failed her exams.en: The text does not say that.

Her family moved abroad.en: The text does not say that.

bloques.correcta: Her father died and she had to work

pregunta.en: How old was she when she graduated in Law?

Thirty-six.en: A los treinta y seis años.

Twenty-six.en: The text says treinta y seis.

Sixteen.en: The text says treinta y seis.

pregunta.en: What did many colleagues ask her to do?

To resign.en: The text does not say that.

To vote against.en: The text does not say that.

pregunta.en: Why «pudieran» and not «podían» in «defendió que las mujeres pudieran votar»?

It was a goal she argued for, not yet a.en: What you argue for takes the subjunctive.

It is a guess about the past.en: A guess would use the conditional.

bloques.correcta: It was a goal she argued for, not yet a fact

pregunta.en: Complete: she graduated at the age of thirty-six.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the biography of a person you admire, in an organised text with dates and turning points.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud the story of your own life in three minutes, choosing what to include.
